summary: Aberrant spectres use a magic attack with a max hit of 8 that Protect from Magic fully negates, but without a nose peg or Slayer helmet they use a special attack that hits through prayer and drains stats fast. They are undead, so a Salve amulet (ei) beats the Slayer helmet bonus, and they drop lots of herbs and seeds so a herb sack and seed box are recommended. The Stronghold Slayer Cave is the usual choice because a cannon can be used there, Nieve or Steve is right outside and a bank is close; the Slayer Tower gives bonus Slayer XP from the Morytania Diary. Deviant spectres in the Catacombs count too but have much higher defence and give lower XP rates.
styleNotes: Undead (Salve amulet works, does not stack with Slayer helmet); 50% elemental weakness to air spells; not poisonous; not immune to cannon.
usefulItems: Dwarf multicannon (Stronghold Slayer Cave or Deepfin Mine)

summary: Abyssal demons hit with an accurate melee stab attack but only max 8, and Protect from Melee negates all damage from them and from the Greater abyssal demon superior. They teleport themselves and can teleport the player up to 20 tiles away, so reading a Teleport anchoring scroll first is strongly recommended. They are 1x1 and ideal for area-of-effect (Ancient Magicks smoke spells, Venator bow) in the two multi-combat spots: the Catacombs of Kourend and the Wilderness Slayer Cave, the latter also allowing a cannon. In single-combat areas such as the Slayer Tower a melee setup with an Expeditious bracelet is recommended. Extend this task as early as possible.
styleNotes: Demon (demonbane weapons and spells apply, but AoE is usually preferred); not immune to cannon; not aggressive, so Dinh's bulwark or a goading potion helps in multi; use melee with an Expeditious bracelet in single-combat areas; Smoke Barrage/Burst preferred over Ice because frozen demons that teleport do not walk back.

summary: Ankou use an inaccurate melee attack with a max hit of 8-10 that Protect from Melee fully negates. They are undead, so a Salve amulet works (but not stacked with the Slayer helmet), and they are aggressive. Unextended tasks are fast with melee even in single combat; in the multi-combat Catacombs of Kourend or Wilderness Slayer Cave they can be bursted or barraged, and a cannon works everywhere except the Catacombs. The Stronghold Slayer Cave is the convenient default (cannon, task-only, near Nieve).
styleNotes: Undead and spectral (Salve amulet, Ectoplasmator and Bonecrusher all apply); elemental weakness to air; not immune to cannon; Protect from Melee negates all damage.
usefulItems: Royal seed pod or other one-click teleport (Wilderness locations)

summary: Aquanites are accurate magic attackers found only in the Ynysdail Cavern, so Protect from Magic is strongly recommended; alternatively they can be safespotted with a 9-10 tile attack range. Hitting one with a slash attack severs its lure and drops its stab defence from 60 to 10, so the usual method is a fast slash weapon followed by a strong stab weapon. The cavern is single-way and a cannon cannot be placed. Reaching Ynysdail needs 73 Sailing and a boat with an adamant keel or better; building the rowboat there (70 Construction) gives a fast route from Gwenith after Song of the Elves.
styleNotes: Attacks with Magic; slash attack severs the lure (stab defence 60 to 10), so use slash then stab; Ranged with a longrange safespot also works; immune to cannon per infobox and cannons cannot be placed anyway.
usefulItems: Slash weapon (scimitar or abyssal whip) to sever the lure
Rune pouch with High Level Alchemy runes

summary: Araxytes are melee attackers in the Morytania Spider Cave that inflict venom, so bring venom immunity (extended anti-venom+ for long trips) and prayer. Kill only the level 146 variant: it has the better drop table and is the only one that can spawn the Dreadborn Araxyte superior. A cannon works throughout the cave and, combined with a Venator bow in the multi-combat rooms, kills them very quickly; barraging is possible if you stack the 2x2 larger araxytes by running through them. The task is very profitable so bring a seed box and herb sack; a spider cave teleport lands at the entrance.
styleNotes: Melee attackers that inflict venom; elemental weakness to fire; level 146 araxytes are 2x2 so barrages are harder to land; cannon plus Venator bow recommended in multi rooms.

summary: Aviansies fly, so they can only be hit with Ranged or Magic (halberds and salamanders are the melee exceptions), and they attack with Ranged. They are Armadylean followers: an Armadyl-aligned item makes them tolerant, but they will still turn on you the moment you attack one. The task must be unlocked with Watch the birdie (80 points) and needs God Wars Dungeon access; the God Wars Dungeon is the normal spot (multi, no cannon, Hard Fremennik Diary notes the adamant bars), while the Wilderness God Wars Dungeon (entrance at level 28 Wilderness) drops bars noted regardless of diary. Many players kill Kree'arra and his bodyguards instead, banking at Nex.
styleNotes: Immune to direct melee except halberds and salamanders; attack with Ranged; elemental weakness to air; not immune to cannon per infobox but cannons are not usable in either dungeon.
requiredItems: Ranged or Magic weapon (or a halberd / salamander)
usefulItems: Crossbow and mith grapple (Kree'arra access, 70 Ranged)
Zarosian item to bank at Nex

summary: Bandits are a Krystilia-only Wilderness task done at the Bandit Camp in level 17-24 Wilderness, a multi-combat area where a cannon makes the task go very quickly. The level 22 guard bandits and level 130 bandits at the southern entrance are aggressive, so enter from the safer eastern entrance (guarded only by giant rats) and consider trapping five of the level 130s inside the pizza shop and general store houses. Guard Bandits, Speedy Keith, Donny the lad and Black Heather all count. A single level 130 bandit in the Wilderness Slayer Cave also counts but is not recommended.
styleNotes: Stab attackers; not immune to cannon; guard bandits are aggressive, camp leaders are not.

summary: Banshees are a low-level task that requires earmuffs or a Slayer helmet, otherwise their scream deals damage and heavily drains stats. They are undead, so a Salve amulet works for players without a Slayer helmet. Normal banshees are on the ground floor of the Slayer Tower (single-way, safespot south of the stairs); Twisted Banshees in the Catacombs of Kourend are usually preferred because they are still easy, safespottable on the bridge between their rooms, and drop far better loot (battlestaves, rune items, herbs, pure essence). Neither location allows a cannon.
styleNotes: Undead and spectral (Salve amulet and Crumble Undead work; Salve does not stack with Slayer helmet); magical melee attack; elemental weakness to air; banshees regenerate 1 HP every 5 ticks so focus one at a time.
alternatives: Screaming twisted banshee (superior of Twisted Banshee)
